QuestInfo.name: [Mr. Lee Airlines] Navigator Otter Rescue
QuestInfo.0: The Feline Pirate Ship was wrecked, and its crew members were scattered. Look for Navigator Otter.
QuestInfo.1: Navigator Otter has agreed to return to the pirate ship if you help him.
QuestInfo.2: You now have a navigator for the Feline Pirate Ship.
